name: computable-systems-engineering
description: Develop a system concept, operations or architecture from one model. Check supported claims and deliver editable, source-linked views.

interface.shortDescription: Develop systems and inspect the evidence.
interface.longDescription: Use eleven skills to explore concepts, connect operations and architecture, define measures and plan evidence from the same project model. Local deterministic tools check supported flows, calculations, queues, failure models and observations against supplied inputs and scope. Deliver editable diagrams and choose reusable SVG components with explicit SysML and SysE contexts, Draw.io libraries and a Kernspan adapter. You decide consequential changes to the model and accepted obligations.
defaultPrompt: Compare these system approaches against my accepted outcomes and constraints. Show which evidence could change the decision.
Walk through the normal handoff and this recovery case. Show who acts, what moves, and how we would recognize completion.
Create an editable view of these model elements. Use the supplied visual reference, check labels at the delivered size, and report which model checks ran.
